name: Cold War Warfare
summary: Cold War Warfare bundles three distinct military strategy games focused on the Cold War era. The package includes Hind, a helicopter combat simulator where players pilot Soviet Mi-24 gunships, Harpoon II: Admiral's Edition, which simulates naval warfare between NATO and Soviet forces, and Perfect General II, a tactical ground combat game. Each title offers different perspectives on Cold War military operations through air, sea, and land warfare scenarios.
